paite: Huan Gilead gam a Tishbi a mi Elijah in Ahab kiang ah, "TOUPA, ama a ka dinna Israelte' Pathian ahin bang in ka gen ahi. Keimah thu lou in kum bangzah hiam sung daitui leh vuah azu kei ding," achi hi.
heading: Elijah Leh Khokheng
english: Elijah the Tishbite, who was one of the settlers of Gilead, said to Ahab, “As Yahweh, the God of Israel, lives, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word.”

paite: TOUPA thu akiang ah ahong tung hi,
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to him, saying,

paite: "Hiai a pan pawt inla, suahlam zuan in pai inla, Jordan gei a om Kerith lui ah va kibu in.
english: “Go away from here, turn eastward, and hide yourself by the brook Cherith, that is before the Jordan.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, huai luitui na dawn dia; huai ah nang hon vak ding in va-ak thu ka pe khinta hi," achi hi.
english: You shall drink from the brook. I have commanded the ravens to feed you there.”

paite: Huchi in akuan a, TOUPA thu bang in ahihta hi. Jordan gei a om Kerith lui ah atengta hi.
english: So he went and did according to Yahweh’s word, for he went and lived by the brook Cherith that is before the Jordan.

paite: Va-akte'n zingsang in tanghou leh sa ahong puak zel ua, nitaklam in tanghou leh sa ahong puak nawn zel uhi. Huai luitui adawn hi.
english: The ravens brought him bread and meat in the morning, and bread and meat in the evening; and he drank from the brook.

paite: Anung deuh in hichi ahong hi a, huai gam a vuah himhim azuk louh ziak in lui ahong kangta hi.
english: After a while, the brook dried up, because there was no rain in the land.

paite: TOUPA thu akiang ah ahong tung a,
heading: Elijah Leh Zarephath A Meithainu
english: Yahweh’s word came to him, saying,

paite: "Thou inla, Zidon gam a Zarephath ah hoh inla, huai ah om in. Nang hon vak ding in meithai khat thu ka pe khinta," achi hi.
english: “Arise, go to Zarephath, which belongs to Sidon, and stay there. Behold, I have commanded a widow there to sustain you.”

paite: Huchi in athou a, Zarephath ah ahohta hi. Huai khokulh kongpi atun in, ngai in, meithai khat sing tom in ana om a; amah asam a, "Bel in tui tawmchik hon la dih ve, ka na dawn ding," achi hi.
english: So he arose and went to Zarephath; and when he came to the gate of the city, behold, a widow was there gathering sticks. He called to her and said, “Please get me a little water in a jar, that I may drink.”

paite: La dia kuan asam a, "Tanghou neuchik bek hon tawi lechin," achi hi.
english: As she was going to get it, he called to her and said, “Please bring me a morsel of bread in your hand.”

paite: Ama'n, TOUPA na Pathian ahin bang in, ka gen hi. "Tanghou ka nei kei, bel ah tangbuang pham khat lel leh thawl ah sathau tawmchik kia ka nei hi. Ngai in, ka pai chia ka tapa a dia bawlna ding singkang nih hiam lel ka tom a, huchi in ka ne ding ua, ka si mai ding uh," achi hi.
english: She said, “As Yahweh your God lives, I don’t have anything baked, but only a handful of meal in a jar and a little oil in a jar. Behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and bake it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.”

paite: Elijah in akiang ah, "Lau ke'n, na gen bang in va hih in. Himahleh huai in tanghou neuchik petmah hon bawlsak phot inla, huai hon tawi inla, huai khit chiang in nang a ding leh na tapa a ding na bawl ding hi.
english: Elijah said to her, “Don’t be afraid. Go and do as you have said; but make me a little cake from it first, and bring it out to me, and afterward make some for you and for your son.

paite: TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian in hichi in achi: TOUPA'N leitung a vuah ahon zuksak masiah tangbuang bel avuak tuan kei dia, sathau thawl leng akang kei ding," achi hi.
english: For Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘The jar of meal will not run out, and the jar of oil will not fail, until the day that Yahweh sends rain on the earth.’”

paite: Huchi in Elijah gen bang in ahih a; amah leh a-inkote leh Elijah toh ni tamtak ane uhi.
english: She went and did according to the saying of Elijah; and she, he, and her household ate many days.

paite: Elijah zang a agen TOUPA thu bang in tangbuang bel avuak tuan kei a, sathau thawl leng akang sam kei hi.
english: The jar of meal didn’t run out and the jar of oil didn’t fail, according to Yahweh’s word, which he spoke by Elijah.

paite: Huai thilte nung in hichi ahong hi a, huai numei, inn neinu tapa china in ahong gim mahmah a, anak ahong beita hi.
heading: Meithai Tapa Hihdamna
english: After these things, the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, became sick; and his sickness was so severe that there was no breath left in him.

paite: Ama'n Elijah kiang ah, "Nang Pathian mipa aw, ka tung a lungkimlouhna bang nei na hia? Ka khelhna hon theikhesak ding leh ka tapa hon thahsak dia hong pai na hi ve!" achi hi.
english: She said to Elijah, “What have I to do with you, you man of God? You have come to me to bring my sin to memory, and to kill my son!”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Na tapa hon pia in," achi hi. Huchi in apom lai ala a, a-omna dantan ah apom tou a, alupna ah asial hi.
english: He said to her, “Give me your son.” He took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into the room where he stayed, and laid him on his own bed.

paite: TOUPA asam a, "Aw TOUPA, ka Pathian, ka tenna meithainu tung ah leh atapa hihlupsak in thil hoih lou hon tungsakta na hi maw?" achi hi.
english: He cried to Yahweh and said, “Yahweh my God, have you also brought evil on the widow with whom I am staying, by killing her son?”

paite: Huchi in naupang tung ah thumvei bokkhup in, TOUPA asam a, "Aw TOUPA, ka Pathian, hehpih in hiai naupang hinna asung ah hon omsak nawn in," achi hi.
english: He stretched himself on the child three times, and cried to Yahweh and said, “Yahweh my God, please let this child’s soul come into him again.”

paite: TOUPA'N Elijah thu ana ngaihkhiaksak hi. Hichi in naupang hinna amah sung ah ahong om nawn a, ahong halh nawnta hi.
english: Yahweh listened to the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.

paite: Elijah in naupang api a, dantan a pan insung ah apaipihsuk a, anu apia hi. Elijah in, “En in, na tapa ahing hi," achi hi.
english: Elijah took the child and brought him down out of the room into the house, and delivered him to his mother; and Elijah said, “Behold, your son lives.”

paite: Numei in Elijah kiang ah, "Tu in Pathian mipa na hi a, na kam a TOUPA thu thutak ahi, chih ka theita," achi hi.
english: The woman said to Elijah, “Now I know that you are a man of God, and that Yahweh’s word in your mouth is truth.”
